article.title: El Salvador Violates Haitian Sovereignty in U.S. Backed Occupation
article.author: bareditors
article.content: El Salvador Violates Haitian Sovereignty in U.S. Backed Occupation Authors Black Agenda Radio with Margaret Kimberley bareditors Fri, 11/20/2026 - 06:49 Dr. Jemima Pierre is a contributing editor at Black Agenda Report and a member of the Black Alliance for Peace and the Anti-Imperialist Scholars Collective . She joins us to discuss Haiti, where troops from El Salvador are the latest to occupy that country in violation of its sovereignty.
